newsitem.title: USA: NTN to pay $1.45 mln to settle class action.
newsitem.headline: NTN to pay $1.45 mln to settle class action.

text.p: NTN Communications Inc siad Friday it agreed to pay $1.45 million to settle a class action suit filed in 1995 against it.
The settlement consists of $250,000 in cash and stock valued at $1.2 million, it said. At its option, it may pay for the settlement entirely in cash, it said.

"Although the company strenuously denied liability, it believes the settlement to be in the best interest of its shareholders," the producer and programer of interactive television said in a statement.
The setttlement is subject to a final court apoproval, it said. The class action alleged securities law violations and was filed in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of California.
It said a similar but separate lawsuit filed by a shareholder in Texas was voluntarily dismissed by the plaintiff and did not require any payment from the company.
